pages.title: 01 // THE SPREADSHEET LIE
pages.content:
You want to analyze corporate earnings: Banking, Oil, Real Estate, Retail.

So you open Excel. You scroll through 500 rows of numbers. Row 12: VCB profit +11,218B. Row 342: PNJ profit -328B. Your eyes blur. Your brain shuts down.

This is spreadsheet fatigue. Loss-making companies love Excel. They hide in tiny 8pt light gray font on page 14. Nobody spots the risk until the quarterly audit fails.

pages.title: 02 // THE SINK OF SHAME & MORPHING SKYLINES
pages.content:
How do you make 50 corporate balance sheets readable in 0.5 seconds? You turn data into a 3D Voxel Metropolis.

Logarithmic algorithms map profit numbers directly to tower heights across an obsidian grid. Profitable giants soar skyward in neon cyan. Loss-making companies don't get a minus sign in a tiny cell—their towers submerge below the obsidian floor into the sub-level and glow Alert Red (#EF4444). You spot contagion before markets open.

pages.title: 03 // INSTANCED MESH & $0.00 RENDER COST
pages.content:
Head-to-Head Duel Mode sweeps the 3D camera in close. A 1px laser measures margin delta in real time.

Live Google Sheets API syncs directly to client GPU via THREE.InstancedMesh. Zero server render fees, 100% real-time financial telemetry. Client-side Zod sanitizer gate latency under 100ms. An unbreakable 3D financial warfare ecosystem.
